resolution.reason: Not a defect in wallet-backend. ParticipantsProcessor.GetTransactionParticipants always adds the envelope's source account ('in case of a fee bump, this is the innerTx source account', participants.go at e967ce8b), and GetOperationParticipants keeps the source of a failed transaction 'so the operation row still exists for the submitter'. Attributing a failed transaction to the account that submitted it is wallet-backend's documented intent and the same at 3e22515a and on main; it stores no state change or movement for that account, and nothing the network did not apply is attributed (no forbidden address appears). The extra participant comes from this kit's stricter rule, under which a source whose sequence number did not move (txBAD_SEQ) or that no longer exists (txNO_ACCOUNT) is an envelope-only claim. The entries keep their exact expectation and the cells are declared.
